synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:

THE GRUFFALO'S CHILD
After learning about the Big Bad Mouse, Gruffalo's daughter chooses to ignore her father's warnings and embarks on a journey to find the creature in the dangerously cold winter.

THE SCARECROW'S WEDDING
Two devoted scarecrows, Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay, are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, a smooth-talking scarecrow named Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

movie_title_en: Family Film Club: Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl
synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl - A tale of adventure set during the 17th Century in the Caribbean Sea. For the roguish yet charming Captain Jack Sparrow, the crystalline waters of the Caribbean, like the high seas the world over, present a vast playground where adventure and mystery abound. But Jack's idyllic life capsizes after his nemesis, the wily Captain Barbossa, steals his ship, the Black Pearl, and later attacks the town of Port Royal, kidnapping the Governor's beautiful daughter, Elizabeth Swann. Elizabeth's childhood friend, Will Turner, joins forces with Jack to commandeer the fastest ship in the British fleet, the HMS Interceptor, in a gallant attempt to rescue her and recapture the Black Pearl.

After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movie_title: Family Film Club: Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl
movie_title_en: Family Film Club: Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl
synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl - A tale of adventure set during the 17th Century in the Caribbean Sea. For the roguish yet charming Captain Jack Sparrow, the crystalline waters of the Caribbean, like the high seas the world over, present a vast playground where adventure and mystery abound. But Jack's idyllic life capsizes after his nemesis, the wily Captain Barbossa, steals his ship, the Black Pearl, and later attacks the town of Port Royal, kidnapping the Governor's beautiful daughter, Elizabeth Swann. Elizabeth's childhood friend, Will Turner, joins forces with Jack to commandeer the fastest ship in the British fleet, the HMS Interceptor, in a gallant attempt to rescue her and recapture the Black Pearl.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Storks deliver babies... or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for global internet giant Cornerstore.com.  Junior, the company's top delivery stork, is about to be promoted when he accidentally activates the Baby Making Machine, producing an adorable and wholly unauthorised baby girl.  Desperate to deliver this bundle of trouble before the boss gets wise, Junior and his friend Tulip, the only human on Stork Mountain, race to make their first-ever baby drop - in a wild and revealing journey that could make more than one family whole and restore the storks' true mission in the world.

synopsis:
Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Wednesday, 19 August, lead your heart with Raya and the Last Dragon. Long ago, in the fantasy world of Kumandra, humans and dragons lived together in harmony. But when sinister monsters known as the Druun threatened the land, the dragons sacrificed themselves to save humanity.

Now, 500 years later, those same monsters have returned, and it's up to a lone warrior, Raya (Kelly Marie Tran), to track down the last dragon, Sisu (Awkwafina), and finally stop the Druun for good. As she journeys across Kumandra in search of the dragon gem's missing pieces, Raya encounters new allies, fierce rivals and unexpected challenges that test everything she believes.

However, along her journey, she'll learn that it will take more than dragon magic to save the world. To restore peace and unite a fractured kingdom, Raya must learn to lead with her heart and place her trust in others.

But when an evil force threatened the land, the dragons sacrificed themselves to save humanity. Now, 500 years later, that same evil has returned and it’s up to a lone warrior, Raya, to track down the legendary last dragon to restore the fractured land and its divided people.

As she journeys across Kumandra in search of the dragon gem's missing pieces, Raya encounters new allies, fierce rivals and unexpected challenges that test everything she believes.

However, along her journey, she'll learn that it will take more than dragon magic to save the world. To restore peace and unite a fractured kingdom, Raya must learn to lead with her heart and place her trust in others.

synopsis:
Storks deliver babies... or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for global internet giant Cornerstore.com.  Junior, the company's top delivery stork, is about to be promoted when he accidentally activates the Baby Making Machine, producing an adorable and wholly unauthorised baby girl.  Desperate to deliver this bundle of trouble before the boss gets wise, Junior and his friend Tulip, the only human on Stork Mountain, race to make their first-ever baby drop - in a wild and revealing journey that could make more than one family whole and restore the storks' true mission in the world.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl - A tale of adventure set during the 17th Century in the Caribbean Sea. For the roguish yet charming Captain Jack Sparrow, the crystalline waters of the Caribbean, like the high seas the world over, present a vast playground where adventure and mystery abound. But Jack's idyllic life capsizes after his nemesis, the wily Captain Barbossa, steals his ship, the Black Pearl, and later attacks the town of Port Royal, kidnapping the Governor's beautiful daughter, Elizabeth Swann. Elizabeth's childhood friend, Will Turner, joins forces with Jack to commandeer the fastest ship in the British fleet, the HMS Interceptor, in a gallant attempt to rescue her and recapture the Black Pearl.

movie_title: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (Extended Edition)
movie_title_en: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (Extended Edition)
synopsis:
Set in mythic pre-historic times, a young hobbit named Frodo Baggins inherits a magic ring from his elderly cousin Bilbo. Wise to the powers that the magic ring holds, the dark Lord Sauron wants it, knowing it will enable him to enslave the people of Middle Earth. In his effort to thwart Sauron, Frodo recruits the fellowship of a wizard, an elf, a dwarf and others on a mission to destroy the ring by casting it into the volcanic fires in the Crack of Doom. However, the ring unleashes its own power as a result of the struggle....

Screening on Sundays and Tuesdays as part of our Throwback Season where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.

synopsis:
Set in mythic pre-historic times, a young hobbit named Frodo Baggins inherits a magic ring from his elderly cousin Bilbo. Wise to the powers that the magic ring holds, the dark Lord Sauron wants it, knowing it will enable him to enslave the people of Middle Earth. In his effort to thwart Sauron, Frodo recruits the fellowship of a wizard, an elf, a dwarf and others on a mission to destroy the ring by casting it into the volcanic fires in the Crack of Doom. However, the ring unleashes its own power as a result of the struggle....

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Storks deliver babies... or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for global internet giant Cornerstore.com.  Junior, the company's top delivery stork, is about to be promoted when he accidentally activates the Baby Making Machine, producing an adorable and wholly unauthorised baby girl.  Desperate to deliver this bundle of trouble before the boss gets wise, Junior and his friend Tulip, the only human on Stork Mountain, race to make their first-ever baby drop - in a wild and revealing journey that could make more than one family whole and restore the storks' true mission in the world.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Thursday, 20 August, hope for a better world with Aladdin. When kind-hearted street thief Aladdin (Mena Massoud) discovers a magic lamp containing a powerful Genie (Will Smith), he is granted the chance to change his life forever. Determined to win the heart of the independent and adventurous Princess Jasmine (Naomi Scott), Aladdin embarks on an unforgettable journey filled with magic, wonder and danger.

As he navigates the bustling streets and grand palaces of Agrabah, Aladdin discovers that true greatness comes not from wishes or wealth, but from believing in yourself and doing what's right. But when the scheming Jafar (Marwan Kenzari) sets out to seize control of the kingdom, Aladdin must find the courage to stay true to who he is and fight for a better world.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl - A tale of adventure set during the 17th Century in the Caribbean Sea. For the roguish yet charming Captain Jack Sparrow, the crystalline waters of the Caribbean, like the high seas the world over, present a vast playground where adventure and mystery abound. But Jack's idyllic life capsizes after his nemesis, the wily Captain Barbossa, steals his ship, the Black Pearl, and later attacks the town of Port Royal, kidnapping the Governor's beautiful daughter, Elizabeth Swann. Elizabeth's childhood friend, Will Turner, joins forces with Jack to commandeer the fastest ship in the British fleet, the HMS Interceptor, in a gallant attempt to rescue her and recapture the Black Pearl.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

movie_title: Family Film Club: Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl
movie_title_en: Family Film Club: Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl
synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl - A tale of adventure set during the 17th Century in the Caribbean Sea. For the roguish yet charming Captain Jack Sparrow, the crystalline waters of the Caribbean, like the high seas the world over, present a vast playground where adventure and mystery abound. But Jack's idyllic life capsizes after his nemesis, the wily Captain Barbossa, steals his ship, the Black Pearl, and later attacks the town of Port Royal, kidnapping the Governor's beautiful daughter, Elizabeth Swann. Elizabeth's childhood friend, Will Turner, joins forces with Jack to commandeer the fastest ship in the British fleet, the HMS Interceptor, in a gallant attempt to rescue her and recapture the Black Pearl.

synopsis: Set on Vancouver Island in the late 1990s, Blue Heron follows eight‑year‑old Sasha and her Hungarian immigrant family as they attempt to build a new life, only to be destabilised by the increasingly dangerous behaviour of her older brother, Jeremy. Drawing on her own memories, filmmaker Sophy Romvari shapes a deeply personal portrait of childhood, family fractures, and the fragility of recollection.
tmdb_overview: In the late 1990s, a family of six settles into their new home on Vancouver Island, as internal dynamics are slowly revealed through the experiences of the youngest child, Sasha. Their fresh start is interrupted by the increasingly dangerous behavior of Jeremy, the family's oldest child.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

Marlin, a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo, who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver and horrified Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory -- who has a short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank.

synopsis: Set on Vancouver Island in the late 1990s, Blue Heron follows eight‑year‑old Sasha and her Hungarian immigrant family as they attempt to build a new life, only to be destabilised by the increasingly dangerous behaviour of her older brother, Jeremy. Drawing on her own memories, filmmaker Sophy Romvari shapes a deeply personal portrait of childhood, family fractures, and the fragility of recollection.
tmdb_overview: In the late 1990s, a family of six settles into their new home on Vancouver Island, as internal dynamics are slowly revealed through the experiences of the youngest child, Sasha. Their fresh start is interrupted by the increasingly dangerous behavior of Jeremy, the family's oldest child.

synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. Once the demons realise her power, our world becomes their playground.

movie_title: Relaxed Screening: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movie_title_en: Relaxed Screening: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
synopsis:
Welcome to Relaxed Screenings - a comfortable and inclusive way to enjoy the magic of the movies in a sensory and autism-friendly environment. Every month, we host a special screening with reduced volume, dimmed lighting, and no ads or trailers, creating a calm and stress-free setting for neurodiverse guests, including those with autism and sensory sensitivities, and their friends, family, and carers.

Join us Sunday, 23 August, for a relaxed screening of Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. 

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

BBFC Content Warning - Spider-Man: Brand New Day is rated 12A with moderate violence, threat, injury detail, and implied strong language. Check the BBFC website for further information: https://www.bbfc.co.uk/release/spider-man-brand-new-day-q29sbgvjdglvbjpwwc0xmtezmty0
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Saturday, 22 August, nothing is impossible with Cinderella. The timeless tale follows Ella (Lily James), a kind-hearted young woman whose life is turned upside down after the loss of her beloved father. Forced to live under the rule of her cruel stepmother, Lady Tremaine (Cate Blanchett), and her jealous stepsisters, Ella refuses to let hardship change her gentle spirit.

When a chance encounter in the woods introduces her to a charming stranger who is secretly the Prince (Richard Madden), Ella discovers that her destiny may be greater than she ever imagined. With a little help from her Fairy Godmother (Helena Bonham Carter), she finds the courage to believe in herself and show that nothing is impossible.

synopsis:
Tired from decades of being blown up by explosive ACME products whilst in pursuit of the uncatchable Road Runner, Wile E. Coyote teams up with lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte) to fight back in COYOTE vs. ACME. But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.

Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.
tmdb_overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

movie_title: Relaxed Screening: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movie_title_en: Relaxed Screening: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
synopsis:
Welcome to Relaxed Screenings - a comfortable and inclusive way to enjoy the magic of the movies in a sensory and autism-friendly environment. Every month, we host a special screening with reduced volume, dimmed lighting, and no ads or trailers, creating a calm and stress-free setting for neurodiverse guests, including those with autism and sensory sensitivities, and their friends, family, and carers.

Join us Sunday, 23 August, for a relaxed screening of Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. 

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

synopsis:
Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Sunday, 23 August, be yourself no matter what with Tangled. Rapunzel  (Mandy Moore) has spent her entire life hidden away in a secluded tower, her magical golden hair guarded by the mysterious Mother Gothel (Donna Murphy). Curious about the world beyond her window and determined to experience life for herself, Rapunzel seizes an unexpected opportunity when charming thief Flynn Rider (Zachary Levi) stumbles into her tower.

Together, the unlikely pair set off on an unforgettable adventure filled with daring escapes, unexpected friendships and magical discoveries. As Rapunzel explores the kingdom for the very first time, she begins to uncover the truth about her past and learns that real freedom comes from being brave enough to follow your dreams

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movie_title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movie_title_en: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
synopsis: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

synopsis: Stop! That! Train! follows best friends Tess (Ginger Minj) and DeeDee (Jujubee), train stewardesses who trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. When a catastrophic “Stormaganza” threatens to derail the high-speed train and crash it into Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first class attendants (Symone, Brooke Lynn Hytes, Marcia Marcia Marcia) and President Gagwell (RuPaul) to save the day in this wild ride of camp and comedy.
tmdb_overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

movie_title: Toddler Club: The Highway Rat + Zog & the Flying Doctors
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: The Highway Rat + Zog & the Flying Doctors
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

THE HIGHWAY RAT
The Highway Rat is a short animation based on a popular children’s story by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler in which a ravenous rat searches for sugary treats to steal.

ZOG AND THE FLYING DOCTORS
Zog and the Flying Doctors is a family animation in which a princess dreams of becoming a doctor.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Monday, 24 August, trust in yourself with The Princess and the Frog. Tiana (Anika Noni Rose) is a hardworking and ambitious young woman in 1920s New Orleans who dreams of opening her own restaurant. When she meets the charming Prince Naveen (Bruno Campos), who has been transformed into a frog by the sinister Dr Facilier (Keith David), an unexpected kiss leaves Tiana facing the same fate.

Together, Tiana and Naveen embark on a magical adventure through the Louisiana bayou in search of a way to break the spell. Along the way, they encounter colourful new friends, unexpected dangers and life-changing lessons about love, friendship and what truly matters. 

As Tiana works towards the future she has always dreamed of, she'll discover that success doesn't come from wishing upon a star alone. It comes from determination, believing in your own abilities and having the courage to trust in yourself.
tmdb_overview: A waitress, desperate to fulfill her dreams as a restaurant owner, is set on a journey to turn a frog prince back into a human being, but she has to face the same problem after she kisses him.

movie_title: Family Film Club: The Parent Trap
movie_title_en: Family Film Club: The Parent Trap
synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Walt Disney's The Parent Trap - identical twins Annie and Hallie meet at summer camp, completely unaware of each other's existence. After discovering they are sisters, they hatch a clever plan: they trade places to meet the parent they never knew and attempt to trick their divorced parents into falling in love again.

tmdb_overview: Frodo Baggins and the other members of the Fellowship continue on their sacred quest to destroy the One Ring--but on separate paths. Their destinies lie at two towers--Orthanc Tower in Isengard, where the corrupt wizard Saruman awaits, and Sauron's fortress at Barad-dur, deep within the dark lands of Mordor. Frodo and Sam are trekking to Mordor to destroy the One Ring of Power while Gimli, Legolas and Aragorn search for the orc-captured Merry and Pippin. All along, nefarious wizard Saruman awaits the Fellowship members at the Orthanc Tower in Isengard.

synopsis:
Join us on Thursday, 6 August, for one night only as David Byrne’s American Utopia returns to Everyman - experience it like never before in stunning 4K alongside a special pre-recorded introduction by David Byrne.

Directed by Oscar-winner Spike Lee, David Byrne’s American Utopia is a groundbreaking cinematic event that inspires audiences to connect with each other and with the global community. 

This filmed version of the electrifying Broadway musical sensation brings Oscar, Grammy, and Golden Globe-winning musician David Byrne (Talking Heads) together with 11 musical artists from around the world to perform songs from across Byrne's career. Hailed by critics as "pure bliss," the performance is a joyful celebration of music and dance, a call to action to engage in our democracy, and an invitation to reimagine our own utopias.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

tmdb_overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

synopsis: Emerging from years in isolation to an enraptured crowd, a transgender, septuagenarian musical genius finally finds his place in the world. Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-traveling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist, as the present finally catches up with him and he embarks on his first international tour at the age of 74. Capturing five decades of relentless musical output and shifting manifestations of gender and sexual identity, set against a ba
tmdb_overview: As a sci-fi obsessed woman living in near isolation, Beverly Glenn-Copeland wrote and self-released Keyboard Fantasies in Huntsville, Ontario back in 1986. Recorded in an Atari-powered home-studio, the cassette featured seven tracks of a curious folk-electronica hybrid, a sound realized far before its time. Three decades on, the musician – now Glenn Copeland – began to receive emails from people across the world, thanking him for the music they’d recently discovered.

tmdb_overview: After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. tmdb_overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

synopsis: Emerging from years in isolation to an enraptured crowd, a transgender, septuagenarian musical genius finally finds his place in the world. Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-traveling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist, as the present finally catches up with him and he embarks on his first international tour at the age of 74. Capturing five decades of relentless musical output and shifting manifestations of gender and sexual identity, set against a ba
tmdb_overview: As a sci-fi obsessed woman living in near isolation, Beverly Glenn-Copeland wrote and self-released Keyboard Fantasies in Huntsville, Ontario back in 1986. Recorded in an Atari-powered home-studio, the cassette featured seven tracks of a curious folk-electronica hybrid, a sound realized far before its time. Three decades on, the musician – now Glenn Copeland – began to receive emails from people across the world, thanking him for the music they’d recently discovered.

synopsis: After 20 years abroad, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her late mother's home. Sorting through long-hidden letters, she begins to excavate a past never spoken of, unearthing a family history entwined with the atomic bomb that fell on 9th August 1945. Eight decades later, the legacy of the bomb hangs heavy like a mist over Nagasaki, as Noriko visits survivors and digs into a past that will help her to heal in the present. Every word of testimony is uttered with dignity, and set against po
tmdb_overview: After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. In doing so, she finds letters that reveal a family secret intertwined with the memory of the peninsular town’s inhabitants. In reconstructing this family story, Okurimono gradually develops into a grace-filled meditation on the passage of time and the legacy we leave behind.

synopsis: Fiercely independent journalist Amy Goodman has spent three decades holding the powerful to account, reporting from war zones and the Democracy Now! newsroom. In STEAL THIS STORY, PLEASE! Oscar-nominated filmmakers Carl Deal and Tia Lessin craft a riveting portrait of journalism’s power – and peril – in an era of corporate control and political attacks on truth.
tmdb_overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-traveling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist, as the present finally catches up with him and he embarks on his first international tour at the age of 74. Capturing five decades of relentless musical output and shifting manifestations of gender and sexual identity, set against a ba
tmdb_overview: As a sci-fi obsessed woman living in near isolation, Beverly Glenn-Copeland wrote and self-released Keyboard Fantasies in Huntsville, Ontario back in 1986. Recorded in an Atari-powered home-studio, the cassette featured seven tracks of a curious folk-electronica hybrid, a sound realized far before its time. Three decades on, the musician – now Glenn Copeland – began to receive emails from people across the world, thanking him for the music they’d recently discovered.

tmdb_overview: After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. In reconstructing this family story, Okurimono gradually develops into a grace-filled meditation on the passage of time and the legacy we leave behind.

synopsis: Emerging from years in isolation to an enraptured crowd, a transgender, septuagenarian musical genius finally finds his place in the world. Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-traveling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist, as the present finally catches up with him and he embarks on his first international tour at the age of 74. Capturing five decades of relentless musical output and shifting manifestations of gender and sexual identity, set against a ba
tmdb_overview: As a sci-fi obsessed woman living in near isolation, Beverly Glenn-Copeland wrote and self-released Keyboard Fantasies in Huntsville, Ontario back in 1986. Recorded in an Atari-powered home-studio, the cassette featured seven tracks of a curious folk-electronica hybrid, a sound realized far before its time. Three decades on, the musician – now Glenn Copeland – began to receive emails from people across the world, thanking him for the music they’d recently discovered.

tmdb_overview: After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. synopsis: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director (Hannah Einbinder, Hacks) for resurrection. But when she visits the original movie’s star (Gillian Anderson, The X-Files, Sex Education), a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

This mythic action movie recounts the story of Odysseus (Damon) on his perilous journey home, troubled by gods and monsters. Meanwhile, his wife Penelope (Hathaway) and son Telemachus (Holland) fight to hold their kingdom together against
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see. The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn’t forgotten them.

movie_title: DOCHOUSE: HOW TO FEED A DICTATOR
movie_title_en: DOCHOUSE: HOW TO FEED A DICTATOR
synopsis: This film tells the story of five brutal regimes, from Iraq to North Korea, through the eyes of the personal chefs who served them. Through recipes, rituals and remembrance, a portrait emerges of power, manipulation and the quiet ways ordinary people become entangled in extraordinary violence. Loyalty, denial, fear, even thrill, each chef carries their experience differently, yet together they reveal how dictatorship gets under the skin of everyone it touches. HOW TO FEED A DICTATOR is darkly fu
tmdb_overview: Five private chefs to fearsome dictators all over the world share their experiences of the kitchens and circumstances that led them to these sometimes dangerous and often morally compromising workplaces.

synopsis: Fiercely independent journalist Amy Goodman has spent three decades holding the powerful to account, reporting from war zones and the Democracy Now! newsroom. In STEAL THIS STORY, PLEASE! Oscar-nominated filmmakers Carl Deal and Tia Lessin craft a riveting portrait of journalism’s power – and peril – in an era of corporate control and political attacks on truth.
tmdb_overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

synopsis: Emerging from years in isolation to an enraptured crowd, a transgender, septuagenarian musical genius finally finds his place in the world. Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-traveling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist, as the present finally catches up with him and he embarks on his first international tour at the age of 74. Capturing five decades of relentless musical output and shifting manifestations of gender and sexual identity, set against a ba
tmdb_overview: As a sci-fi obsessed woman living in near isolation, Beverly Glenn-Copeland wrote and self-released Keyboard Fantasies in Huntsville, Ontario back in 1986. Recorded in an Atari-powered home-studio, the cassette featured seven tracks of a curious folk-electronica hybrid, a sound realized far before its time. Three decades on, the musician – now Glenn Copeland – began to receive emails from people across the world, thanking him for the music they’d recently discovered.

synopsis: After 20 years abroad, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her late mother's home. Sorting through long-hidden letters, she begins to excavate a past never spoken of, unearthing a family history entwined with the atomic bomb that fell on 9th August 1945. Eight decades later, the legacy of the bomb hangs heavy like a mist over Nagasaki, as Noriko visits survivors and digs into a past that will help her to heal in the present. Every word of testimony is uttered with dignity, and set against po
tmdb_overview: After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. In doing so, she finds letters that reveal a family secret intertwined with the memory of the peninsular town’s inhabitants. In reconstructing this family story, Okurimono gradually develops into a grace-filled meditation on the passage of time and the legacy we leave behind.

movie_title: DOCHOUSE: HOW TO FEED A DICTATOR
movie_title_en: DOCHOUSE: HOW TO FEED A DICTATOR
synopsis: This film tells the story of five brutal regimes, from Iraq to North Korea, through the eyes of the personal chefs who served them. Through recipes, rituals and remembrance, a portrait emerges of power, manipulation and the quiet ways ordinary people become entangled in extraordinary violence. synopsis: Fiercely independent journalist Amy Goodman has spent three decades holding the powerful to account, reporting from war zones and the Democracy Now! newsroom. In STEAL THIS STORY, PLEASE! Oscar-nominated filmmakers Carl Deal and Tia Lessin craft a riveting portrait of journalism’s power – and peril – in an era of corporate control and political attacks on truth.
tmdb_overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

synopsis: Emerging from years in isolation to an enraptured crowd, a transgender, septuagenarian musical genius finally finds his place in the world. Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-traveling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist, as the present finally catches up with him and he embarks on his first international tour at the age of 74. Capturing five decades of relentless musical output and shifting manifestations of gender and sexual identity, set against a ba
tmdb_overview: As a sci-fi obsessed woman living in near isolation, Beverly Glenn-Copeland wrote and self-released Keyboard Fantasies in Huntsville, Ontario back in 1986. Recorded in an Atari-powered home-studio, the cassette featured seven tracks of a curious folk-electronica hybrid, a sound realized far before its time. Three decades on, the musician – now Glenn Copeland – began to receive emails from people across the world, thanking him for the music they’d recently discovered.

tmdb_overview: After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. synopsis: Fiercely independent journalist Amy Goodman has spent three decades holding the powerful to account, reporting from war zones and the Democracy Now! newsroom. In STEAL THIS STORY, PLEASE! Oscar-nominated filmmakers Carl Deal and Tia Lessin craft a riveting portrait of journalism’s power – and peril – in an era of corporate control and political attacks on truth.
tmdb_overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

synopsis: Emerging from years in isolation to an enraptured crowd, a transgender, septuagenarian musical genius finally finds his place in the world. Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-traveling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist, as the present finally catches up with him and he embarks on his first international tour at the age of 74. Capturing five decades of relentless musical output and shifting manifestations of gender and sexual identity, set against a ba
tmdb_overview: As a sci-fi obsessed woman living in near isolation, Beverly Glenn-Copeland wrote and self-released Keyboard Fantasies in Huntsville, Ontario back in 1986. Recorded in an Atari-powered home-studio, the cassette featured seven tracks of a curious folk-electronica hybrid, a sound realized far before its time. Three decades on, the musician – now Glenn Copeland – began to receive emails from people across the world, thanking him for the music they’d recently discovered.

Eight decades later, the legacy of the bomb hangs heavy like a mist over Nagasaki, as Noriko visits survivors and digs into a past that will help her to heal in the present. tmdb_overview: After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. In doing so, she finds letters that reveal a family secret intertwined with the memory of the peninsular town’s inhabitants. In reconstructing this family story, Okurimono gradually develops into a grace-filled meditation on the passage of time and the legacy we leave behind.

synopsis: Fiercely independent journalist Amy Goodman has spent three decades holding the powerful to account, reporting from war zones and the Democracy Now! newsroom. In STEAL THIS STORY, PLEASE! Oscar-nominated filmmakers Carl Deal and Tia Lessin craft a riveting portrait of journalism’s power – and peril – in an era of corporate control and political attacks on truth.
tmdb_overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.
